item.title: Seaford man arrested after traffic stop leads to stolen firearm charges

item.title: UPDATE: Thousands Across Delmarva Remain Without Power After Blizzard
item.description: UPDATE: While many have been reconnected to their electricity, thousands across Delmarva are still without power.
